name: ArenaHeroAlign
description: Whether a hero's words run from the start edge or sit centred in their column. ArenaPageHeadAlign carries this exact set for a different subject: that one aligns an actions block against a title across a row, and this aligns a whole column of text within itself. Sharing the name would have put a page head in the type of a member no page head is involved in, and the near miss is worth stating rather than leaving for a later reader to find.
